name: uses injected time and finds the rightmost value at or before a query
test:
clock = FrozenClock(5); table = TimeMap(clock)
assert table.set('k', 'five') == 5
table.set('k', 'one', 1); table.set('k', 'three', 3.5)
assert table.get('k', 0) == ''
assert table.get('k', 3.5) == 'three'
assert table.get('k', 4) == 'three'
assert table.get('k') == 'five'
assert table.get('missing', 99) == ''

name: later duplicate timestamp wins by write sequence not value ordering
test:
clock = FrozenClock(); table = TimeMap(clock)
table.set('k', 'zebra', 7); table.set('k', 'apple', 7)
assert table.get('k', 7) == 'apple'

name: monotonic map remains increasing after backward clock movement
input: clock moves backward between implicit writes
test:
clock = FrozenClock(10); table = MonotonicTimeMap(clock)
first = table.set('k', 'a'); clock.set(2); second = table.set('k', 'b')
assert first == 10 and second > first
assert table.get('k', second) == 'b'
assert table.get('k', first) == 'a'
